title: Affine-Image Propagation for Tight and Scalable Neural Network Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.26978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While bound propagation methods are highly effective for certifying neural networks against $\ell_{\infty}$ adversaries, tight and scalable verification for $\ell_{2}$ adversaries remains a significant open challenge. Existing methods incur geometric loss by enclosing preactivation sets in elementwise intervals or axis-aligned ellipsoids, and functional loss by restricting the linear bounds constructed over those domains. Consequently, tight $\ell_{2}$ verification is currently restricted to Lipschitz-regularized networks where these approximations are accurate. In this paper, we introduce affine-image SDP-CROWN, a novel bound propagation method that better approximates preactivation domains using affine-image constraints and jointly optimizes the linear bound to adapt to the resulting domain. tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的边界传播方法 affine-image SDP-CROWN，通过仿射图像约束更精确地近似预激活域并联合优化线性边界，从而实现对 $\ell_{2}$ 对抗攻击紧凑且可扩展的神经网络验证。
